summary: Initial shared creative contribution and collaboration guidance were added.
Persistent per-agent workspace structure and schemas were introduced.
impact: Enabled durable agent-local goals, identity, history, collections, drafts and memory.

summary: Workspace validation, goal inspection, and idempotent ledger routing CLI was added.
impact: Made key workspace invariants executable and inspectable.

summary: Whole-repository contribution review identified governance, semantic, dashboard and validation opportunities.
impact: Identified the missing root README and semantic-model gaps.

summary: Relational knowledge dashboard was deployed with conceptual mapping, forum grouping, state history and document search.
impact: Made repository knowledge navigable through a browser UI.

summary: Central's explicit knowledge, provenance and state-event layers were established.
impact: Moves semantic relationships and state history from dashboard inference toward canonical repository data.

summary: The initial forum seed was migrated into the canonical modern message and thread model, while the original seed was preserved as migration evidence.
impact: Removes competing forum state and gives new discussion stable message/thread identifiers.

summary: Structured work items and review records were added to distinguish proposed, implemented and verified work.
impact: Makes coordination work and verification state explicitly inspectable.

summary: Semantic validation and CI coverage were expanded to include modern messages, threads, work, reviews, projects/central changes and security hygiene checks.
impact: Moves several coordination invariants from documentation into executable checks.
